sandboxes_empty_desc: Create one here, or acquire via the SDK — either way it shows up in this table within two seconds.
sandboxes_no_match_desc: Try a different keyword or state.
sandboxes_cpu_col_title: Percent is per single vCPU; with multiple vCPUs it can exceed 100%
sandboxes_disk_col_title: The cap is a nominal quota: sparse image, unwritten space uses no host disk
sandboxes_bulk_destroy_desc: The sandboxes are destroyed along with their disks and cannot be recovered. The names stay available — the next acquire with the same name gets a brand-new empty sandbox.
sandboxes_destroy_desc: The sandbox is destroyed along with its disk and cannot be recovered. The name stays available — the next acquire with the same name gets a brand-new empty sandbox.
sandboxes_create_desc: acquire is idempotent: if the name already has a sandbox you get that one back, and the template and policy below are not applied.
sandboxes_name_exists_desc: This name already has a sandbox ({state}) — submitting takes it back as is, and the template and policy below are not applied.
sandboxes_name_desc: A unique name you choose; acquire is idempotent on it — the same name always returns the same sandbox.
sandboxes_template_desc: Only applies when this key actually creates a new sandbox; silently ignored for an existing one.
sandboxes_freeze_desc_create: Idle threshold for Running → Frozen: memory is squeezed into swap, waking takes about 50ms.
sandboxes_freeze_desc: Running → Frozen: memory is squeezed into swap, waking takes about 50ms.
sandboxes_stop_desc_create: Idle threshold for Frozen → Stopped: only the disk remains; waking is a cold start.
sandboxes_stop_desc: Frozen → Stopped: only the disk remains; waking is a cold start.
sandboxes_archive_desc_create: Stopped → Archived: the disk is compressed and uploaded to S3, zero local footprint; waking downloads and extracts — slow but with real progress.
sandboxes_archive_desc: Stopped → Archived: the disk is compressed and uploaded to S3, zero local footprint.
sandboxes_edit_policy_desc: Takes effect immediately and only changes the ledger — sleeping sandboxes are not woken and the idle clock is not reset (new thresholds judge against idle time already accrued).
sandboxes_policy_mixed_note: Selected sandboxes currently have different policies; submitting unifies them to the values below.
sandboxes_rebuild_desc: Swap the shell, keep the disk: next use runs on the daemon's current image. Not a byte of /home/user is lost; running processes and changes outside the home directory evaporate with the old shell.
sandboxes_rebuilt_toast: Rebuilt {name} — /home/user kept, next use runs on the current image
sandboxes_restoring_note: Returns to Running automatically once the restore finishes; destroy is rejected (409) in the meantime, let it run to completion.
sandboxes_archived_headline: Archived: the disk is stored compressed in S3, zero local footprint
sandboxes_archived_desc: Restore = download the archive, extract it onto a fresh disk, then rebuild the container on the template's current image — so restoring is upgrading. Terminal/files become available only after the restore completes.
sandboxes_upgradable_title: Running {image}, template now {nextImage} — Rebuild to swap
sandboxes_cpu_hint: {n} vCPU · percent is per single vCPU
sandboxes_disk_hint: Nominal {total} — sparse image pays only for real content
sandboxes_no_container_desc: The sandbox has no live container right now (stopped/archived). Observing never wakes it — opening a terminal or running a command does. The history below is still here.
sandboxes_no_history_title: Nothing to chart in this window yet
sandboxes_no_history_desc: The daemon samples periodically (every 30 seconds by default) and starts drawing once two points exist; periods when the sandbox is stopped or the daemon is down have no samples, so the curve honestly breaks.
sandboxes_footer_live: Live values refresh every 5 seconds; this reading is from {ago}.
sandboxes_footer_history: History is sampled and stored by the daemon in the background; a sleeping sandbox is still measured (observing never wakes it), and after a stop the curve honestly cuts off.
sandboxes_footer_bucketed: Long window: aggregated into {n}-minute buckets, each point is the peak within its bucket.
